issue_title: [Feature] Add __str__ method for user-friendly string representation

triage_summary.root_cause: Todo class has __repr__ but no __str__, causing print(todo) to use debug format instead of user-friendly format
risk_points: Text sanitization needed to prevent terminal injection
Avoided circular dependency by inlining sanitization logic

implementation.approach: Added __str__ method and _sanitize_text static method to Todo class

acceptance_criteria.criterion: str(Todo(1, 'buy milk', False)) returns '[ ] #1: buy milk'
str(Todo(1, 'buy milk', True)) returns '[x] #1: buy milk'
Output is under 80 chars for normal todos
